Rodas Alba Description


General Description

ALBA is a water-based wall decorative paint with special pearlescent pigment intended for internal application. It creates many different metallic finishes with deep surface elegance. It is odorless, non–toxic, and washable.


Download the specification in PDF

Advantages

  • Easy application
  • Low odor and low VOC level
  • Ready to use
  • It can be tinted with a variety of desired colors

Characteristics and Physical Properties

Color
Appearance Metallic
Grades Smooth, Fine, Medium, Coarse
Sp. Weight 1.0 Kg/Ltr.
Method of Application Brush, Roller, Spatula, Leather cloth, Trowel
Coverage 8–12 m²/Kg. depending on the porosity of the surface and type of application.
Drying time 3–4 Hours
Dilution 5–10% with fresh water
VOC 52 g/Ltr.

Surface Preparation

New Concrete:
  • It should be fully cured at least 28 days and the substrate must be free from any form of contaminants.
  • Ensure that the surface to be coated is sound and clean.
  • The substrate must be primed by Masonry AR Primer, Masonry Primer, PVA Wall filler, sanding, and intermediate coat with cryl (any color) or decorative basecoat.
Old Concrete:
  • All blisters, cracks and peeled off paint should be removed.
  • Remove any loose or flaking material back to a sound firm edge.
  • Treat any organic growth with a fungicidal wash.
  • Penetrated paint must be cleared and treated with 3% ammonia and water.
  • Glossy finish coat must be sanded.
Method of Application:
  • Surface to be coated must be prepared as ready for painting.
  • Apply ALBA to the surface with a trowel both vertically and horizontally to achieve a consistent. Work in 1–2 m² sections at a time. For a smoother finish, lightly run a smoothing spatula across the surface to remove any stipple.
  • At the edges (architrave, picture rail, and skirting) or corners, apply the ALBA with a paintbrush and smoothen with a trowel or spatula.
  • Leave to dry for about 3–4 hours under drying condition and lightly sand the surface with sand, not to the extent of destroying the effect of the paint.
  • Apply the final layer of the paint to the surface with the desired design using either Brush, Roller, Trowel, Leather cloth as thin as possible and work with the chosen tools in a motion that will create a unique design.

Storage and Packing

Shelf life 12 months minimum if stored below 25°C. Protect from frost

Protect from the source of sunlight and direct heat. Keep container sealed when not in use.

Available in 1 Liter, 4 Kg, 10 Kg.

Physiological Hazards

ALBA is nontoxic, nevertheless, good ventilation in working rooms is recommended as well as the use of safety tools and equipment.

It is harmful if swallowed or contacted with eye

Rodas Aqua Metallic is a water-based paint based on vinyl versatate copolymer with luster pigment that gives a brilliant metallic decorative finish. It is odorless, non-toxic, and washable, ideal to use on gypsum, cornices, frames for antique finishes, and a top coat for steel decoration.

Advantages

  • Easy application
  • Low odor and low VOC level
  • Ready to use
  • It can be tinted with a variety of desired colors

Characteristics and Physical Properties

Appearance Metallic
Sp. Weight 1.00 Kg/Ltr.
Method of Application Brush, Roller, Spatula, Leather cloth, Trowel
Coverage 6-8 m2/Kg depending on the type of application.
Flash point Non-flammable
Dilution Fresh water if required
VOC 75 g/Ltr.

Surface Preparation

New Concrete:
  • The substrate must be primed by Rodas Masonry primer, putty filler sanding, and intermediate coat with mascryl (any color) steel.
  • Surface to be coated must be degreased and de-rusted. It must be clean and dry prior to the application of an appropriate primer.
Steel:
  • Apply Rodas Aqua Metallic by brush, roller or spray.
Storage:
  • Shelf life 12months minimum if stored below 25oC.
Cleaning of Tools:
  • All tools should be cleaned with water as soon as possible.
Packaging:

Method of Application:

There are so many ways of Applying Rodas Aqua Metallic by normal brush, roller sponge, spatula leather cloth, and spray gun.

Rodas Aqua Metallic can be over coated with a contrast color of the same material to give a unique design.

Physiological Hazards:

Rodas Aqua Metallic does not contain solvents, nevertheless, good ventilation in working rooms is recommended as well as the use of safety tools and equipment. Rodas Aqua Metallic is harmful if swallowed. If contact with eyes or skin occurs, wash well with freshwater and seek immediate medical advice.

Rodas DAMASCO Description


General Description

Rodas DAMASCO is decorative covering for interior walls based on special natural raw materials giving an antique look, achieving this original RODAS DAMASCO effect, which is especially suitable for classical as well as for modern style decoration. The product is given a high level of breathability, prevents mildew and fungi growth, and environment friendly.


Download the specification in PDF

Characteristics and Physical Properties

Viscosity Pasty
Gloss Eggshell
Theo. yield 150 ~ 200 g/m2
Shelf life 12 months
VOC 75 g/Ltr.

Storage:

  • The product must be stored in accordance with national requisitions. The product should be kept in a cool and well-ventilated place, protected from heat direct sunlight, containers must be kept tightly closed.

Packing:

  • Rodas DAMASCO is available in 1kg, 4kg, and 20 kg PAIL .

Surface Preparation

  • For the new concrete, it should be fully cured at least 28 days and the substance must be free from any form of contaminants.

  • Level the surface with PVA Wall Filler if necessary and sand until smooth
  • Apply 1 – 2 coats of Masonry Primer tinted with the desired color.
  • Apply 1 – 2 coats of RODAS DAMASCO tinted and diluted with 30% with water as a base coat.
  • Apply the effect coat using the explained tools and technique

Safety Measures

Use in a well-ventilated area.

Wear gloves to avoid skin contact.

Avoid contact with eyes; rinse with water if needed.

Keep out of reach of children.

Rodas GALAXY Description


General Description

Rodas GALAXY is a water-based decorative paint reminding the spectacular effect of outer space galaxies. It is easy to apply and available in a wide range of colors. This paint is very resistant and washable.


Download the specification in PDF

Characteristics and Physical Properties

Composition Acrylic resins, Special pigments and Glitters
Diluents Water
Theo. Yield 5 - 8 m²/Ltr.
Appearance Satin matt
Gloss Eggshell
Dilution 5–10% with fresh water
VOC 80 g/Ltr.
Storage Keep in a closed container at room temperature.
Washing Resistance Washes well with water or common detergent
Application By brush, roller or trowel

Surface Preparation

NEW CONCRETE WALLS:
  • the wall should be fully dry without alkaline substance and it should be smooth. Otherwise, scrape with PVA Wall filler, then sand with 180 grit sandpaper. Apply one (1) coat of MAS Masonry Primer White or Mascryl prior to the application of Galaxy
NEW WOOD:
  • application of PVA Wall filler (if necessary), then sand with 280 – grit sandpaper until a smooth surface is obtained. Apply one (1) coat of RODAS Undercoat White and two (2) coats of Galaxy with an interval of 5 – 6 hours at room temperature with Smoothen with 280 – 300 grit sandpaper to facilitate the adhesion of Primary 300 and then the Galaxy.
NEW IRON:
  • smoothen the surface with sandpaper. Remove traces of oil, grease, and other contaminants and apply one (1) coat of Deruster. Apply one (1) cot of Primary 300 prior to the application of two (2) coats of Galaxy.
LIGHT ALLOYS:
  • sremove grease and smooth the surface and apply a coat of adequate primer. Apply one (1) coat of Primary 300 before the application of Galaxy.
Method of Application:
  • To obtain the best effect and quality results, we suggest the following application recommendations. To attain an excellent finish, it is advisable to apply a primer coat. It can be applied on various surfaces like concrete walls, plaster, wood panels, iron ad-light alloys, etc. after previous preparation

Technical Features

Application & Drying:Apply RODAS GALAXY between 50°C and 400°C. Dries to touch in 1 hour at 20°C and fully cures in 3–24 hours depending on conditions.

Durability & Cleaning:Once dry, the coating is abrasion-resistant and resists alcohol, water, and common soaps. Clean tools immediately with water.

Storage & Packaging:Store in a cool, ventilated place away from heat and sunlight. Available in 5 kg and 25 kg packs.

NOTE

To obtain obvious and shining glitter, allow the paint to dry for about 24 hours. Soak a sponge on clean water and try to rinse the paint carefully until all glitters will be visible.

The color in the catalog serves only as guidelines and we cannot guarantee the perfect reproduction of the colors.

Rodas LINOL ART is a water-based and transpiring decorative paint with particular and beautiful sainted, antique and classic effects. Download the specification in PDF

Characteristics and Physical Properties

Appearance As per catalogue
Sp. Weight 1.00 Kg/Ltr.
Coverage 5-6 m2/Ltr.
Application temperature 5oC - 30oC
Resistance Good resistance for abrasion once hardened.
Washability Good after hardened using water and normal detergent.
Stability Approximately one (1) year min. into the packaging.

General Description

New Concrete:

  • The surface must be clean, structurally sound, and free from all contaminants including curing compounds, form release agents, dust, dirt, oil, old coatings, and paint.
  • New concrete and masonry surfaces should be cured for at least 28 days. Provide an absorptive surface on all substrates including smooth precast or formed concrete.
  • The moisture content of the concrete should be below 4% by weight.
  • All laitance must be removed prior to the next step in surface preparation.All laitance must be removed prior to the next step in surface preparation.All laitance must be removed prior to the next step in surface preparation.All laitance must be removed prior to the next step in surface preparation.All laitance must be removed prior to the next step in surface preparation.
  • Remove from marks and other protrusions.
  • Ensure that the surface is fully dry prior to the application of the corresponding primer and subsequent coating.

Old Concrete:

  • Old concrete should be clean and in a good state. Cracks, holes, and other irregularities should be filled in.
  • All blistered, cracks and peeled-off paints should be removed either by grit blasting, mechanical sanding, or paint stripper.
  • Penetrated paint must be cleaned and treated with an ammonia solution.
  • Glossy finish coat must be sanded.
  • Oils and greases are best removed by steam cleaning in conjunction with a detergent solution. Thorough scrubbing with hot caustic solutions will also remove mineral oils and greases.

Old Wood, Old Iron:

  • Previously painted with alkyds and P.U. paints.

  • Remove grease from the surface and sand well.

  • Smoothen with 280 – 300 grit sandpaper to facilitate the adhesion of the subsequent primer.

NEW Iron:

  • Smoothen the surface with sandpaper.

  • Remove traces of oil, grease, and other contaminants and apply one (1) coat of Standard Duster.

  • Apply one (1) coat of anti-corrosive primer to protect the surface from rust.

Application Procedure:

Please ensure that the surface is properly prepared with the application of Rodas Masonry AR Primer as an impregnating sealer to protect the concrete from efflorescence, Rodas PVA Wall Filler (if necessary to even up surface irregularities.) and Mascryl (as specified) as an intermediate coat prior to the application of Rodas LINOL ART. It is imperative to ensure that the surface to be coated should be free from other contaminants, oil, grease, and concrete laitance.

Classic Effect:

  • Spatula

  • Ensure that the surface is fully dry, clean, and free from any contaminants. Apply Mascryl (specified color) using the special brush and keep it dry.

  • Apply RODAS LINOL ART with a stainless steel trowel, using an uneven stroke between 15 – 30 cm. long in all directions, leaving a thin and irregular layer of the product on the surface. After 5-6 hours, apply the second coat, using the same method as for the first coat. Wait for approximately 1 hour and smoothen the coated surface with the same trowel horizontally and vertically

  • for about 15-20 cm. long in all directions with a small amount of pressure to achieve a crushed and small particle thus creating a classical chromatic effect.

  • Brush + Spatula

  • This classic effect can also be achieved by applying RODAS LINOL ART with a suitable brush in all directions for about 8-12 cm. long, moving from right to left and vice versa, and from bottom to top and vice versa, leaving a thin layer of the product, which is more or less uneven. Let it dry for 20 minutes, smoothen the coated surface with a stainless steel trowel, moving in all directions. After 5-6 hours, apply the second coat of RODAS LINOL ART with the brush, with the same method as the first coat.

Note:
When the product is applied for outdoors, please ensure that the coating is fully dry prior to the application RODAS Protect as a protective coating.

Normally 4 Kg, and 20 Kg in a plastic bucket are available upon request.

    • To obtain the best effect and quality results, we suggest the following application recommendations. To attain an excellent finish, it is advisable to apply a primer coat. It can be applied on various surfaces like concrete walls, plaster, wood panels, iron ad-light alloys, etc. after previous preparation

    Technical Features

    Application & Drying:Apply RODAS GALAXY between 50°C and 400°C. Dries to touch in 1 hour at 20°C and fully cures in 3–24 hours depending on conditions.

    Durability & Cleaning:Once dry, the coating is abrasion-resistant and resists alcohol, water, and common soaps. Clean tools immediately with water.

    Storage & Packaging:Store in a cool, ventilated place away from heat and sunlight. Available in 5 kg and 25 kg packs.

    To obtain obvious and shining glitter, allow the paint to dry for about 24 hours. Soak a sponge on clean water and try to rinse the paint carefully until all glitters will be visible.

    Rodas GALAXY Description


    General Description

    Rodas GALAXY is a water-based decorative paint reminding the spectacular effect of outer space galaxies. It is easy to apply and available in a wide range of colors. This paint is very resistant and washable.


    Download the specification in PDF

    Characteristics and Physical Properties

    Composition Acrylic resins, Special pigments and Glitters
    Diluents Water
    Theo. Yield 5 - 8 m²/Ltr.
    Appearance Satin matt
    Gloss Eggshell
    Dilution 5–10% with fresh water
    VOC 80 g/Ltr.
    Storage Keep in a closed container at room temperature.
    Washing Resistance Washes well with water or common detergent
    Application By brush, roller or trowel

    Surface Preparation

    NEW CONCRETE WALLS:
    • the wall should be fully dry without alkaline substance and it should be smooth. Otherwise, scrape with PVA Wall filler, then sand with 180 grit sandpaper. Apply one (1) coat of MAS Masonry Primer White or Mascryl prior to the application of Galaxy
    NEW WOOD:
    • application of PVA Wall filler (if necessary), then sand with 280 – grit sandpaper until a smooth surface is obtained. Apply one (1) coat of RODAS Undercoat White and two (2) coats of Galaxy with an interval of 5 – 6 hours at room temperature with Smoothen with 280 – 300 grit sandpaper to facilitate the adhesion of Primary 300 and then the Galaxy.
    NEW IRON:
    • smoothen the surface with sandpaper. Remove traces of oil, grease, and other contaminants and apply one (1) coat of Deruster. Apply one (1) cot of Primary 300 prior to the application of two (2) coats of Galaxy.
    LIGHT ALLOYS:
    • sremove grease and smooth the surface and apply a coat of adequate primer. Apply one (1) coat of Primary 300 before the application of Galaxy.
    Method of Application:
    • To obtain the best effect and quality results, we suggest the following application recommendations. To attain an excellent finish, it is advisable to apply a primer coat. It can be applied on various surfaces like concrete walls, plaster, wood panels, iron ad-light alloys, etc. after previous preparation

    Technical Features

    Application & Drying:Apply RODAS GALAXY between 50°C and 400°C. Dries to touch in 1 hour at 20°C and fully cures in 3–24 hours depending on conditions.

    Durability & Cleaning:Once dry, the coating is abrasion-resistant and resists alcohol, water, and common soaps. Clean tools immediately with water.

    Storage & Packaging:Store in a cool, ventilated place away from heat and sunlight. Available in 5 kg and 25 kg packs.

    NOTE

    To obtain obvious and shining glitter, allow the paint to dry for about 24 hours. Soak a sponge on clean water and try to rinse the paint carefully until all glitters will be visible.
